concerns.text: The plan states that `data/derived/entropy_matrix.parquet` will be produced, but the `entropy_schema.schema.yaml` contract requires additional metadata fields (n_subjects, n_parcels, scales, r_values, seed, includes_noise_variance, resampling_correlation, ks_pvalue). The plan does not mention generating or recording this metadata, violating the contract.

Two entropy contracts are present (`entropy.schema.yaml` and `entropy_schema.schema.yaml`). The plan only references the simple schema (subject_id, parcel_id, entropy, checksum) and ignores the richer schema, creating ambiguity about which contract the artifact must satisfy.
The `stat_results.schema.yaml` contract mandates a `checksum` column for each row in `results/model_coefficients.csv`, yet the plan’s description of the output does not mention this column.

The `statistical_result_schema.schema.yaml` contract expects a `partial_corr_entropy_dsrt` field in the statistical results, but the plan’s output specification (`model_coefficients.csv`) does not include this column.

The data model defines a `SensitivityRecord` entity (r, m, significant_parcels). The plan only mentions that sensitivity tables will appear in the PDF report; it does not produce a dedicated CSV or Parquet file matching the `SensitivityRecord` schema, leaving the contract unfulfilled.

The plan’s statistical modeling step lists `FR‑004, FR‑005, FR‑006, FR‑008` but does not explicitly state that the output will conform to the `stat_results.schema.yaml` or `statistical_result_schema.schema.yaml` contracts (e.g., column names, data types). This omission makes it unclear whether the required schema will be satisfied.
